summary.text: Jay Livingstone is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 8th Suffolk District since July 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities.

paragraphs.text: Livingstone assumed office on July 17, 2013, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
He was assigned to the Joint Committee on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities, as chair, in both the 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 sessions.
